claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; seed a real plan, change demo data, reset, and assert the real key remains untouched

fresh browser context at /demo; after the app loads, scan a private JPEG and export its ledger and ZIP; assert no request carries photo or plan data and any render-time request is only the known same-origin illustration
fresh browser context at /demo; wait for the service-worker cache, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample plan renders

claim: Downloads portable XMP sidecars and a JSON decision ledger in one ZIP while preserving source folder paths.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download the ZIP and inspect the sample sidecar paths and audit ledger

claim: The core workflow is free and needs no purchase or account.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert its two repair proposals and exports are available without sign-in, account state, or purchase UI

claim: Reads documented JPEG EXIF capture dates, camera make and model, and OffsetTimeOriginal; reports PNG, HEIC, and TIFF as unsupported.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; scan a valid JPEG carrying the documented EXIF fields and assert the rendered values, then scan PNG, HEIC, and TIFF inputs and assert the unsupported result

claim: Flags EXIF date-field disagreements and exact whole-hour file-date patterns without rounding nearby differences.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; scan valid EXIF JPEGs with a field disagreement, an exact +8-hour file-date delta, and a +1-hour-20-minute delta; assert only the first two are proposed

claim: Scanning and exporting never edit the original photo files.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; hash a valid source JPEG before scanning and both exports, then hash the same file afterward and assert the bytes are identical

claim: The browser stores repair-plan metadata until it is cleared, but never stores photo bytes.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; scan a valid JPEG, inspect browser storage, reload to prove retention, reset to prove deletion, and assert no photo payload is present in local storage, session storage, IndexedDB, or cache storage

claim: There are no analytics, trackers, advertising, or third-party runtime assets.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; capture all traffic and cookies across the sample workflow and assert only known same-origin static app resources are requested, with no XHR, fetch, beacon, or cookie activity
